instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up. In a dark dance studio, a group of dancers perform. On the left, the woman in the yellow shirt (R2) stands with arms raised, looking upward. In the center foreground, the profile man in the rust shirt (R3) has his back partially turned, arm reaching up. Behind him, the bearded man in the rust shirt (R1) is partially visible, looking forward. On the right, the woman in the yellow shirt with a ponytail (R4) looks to the right with raised arms. Their hands and arms overlap in a dense, expressive cluster. Soft overhead lighting highlights their forms against the dark background.

R3 is in the center foreground with his back partially turned and an arm reaching up
R1 is partially visible behind R3 while looking forward
